pkgmetadata.longdescription: Phobos is the D standard library and Druntime is the D language runtime. This package matches Arch extra/libphobos: headers under /usr/include/dlang/dmd and libraries in the system libdir, consumed by dev-lang/dmd via /etc/dmd.conf. Compiled with dev-lang/dmd-bootstrap so it can be installed before dmd. Because a release's Druntime and Phobos need a compiler of that same release, this package builds a throwaway stage1 dmd from the bundled compiler source and uses it for the runtime.
